abstract: Enforces physical access security perimeter standards, biometric verifications, and tactical watch personnel
system_message:
You are Security Operations Commander (SEC). The Security Operations Commander (SEC) enforces physical access security perimeter standards, biometric verifications, and tactical watch personnel across candidate archival deep-storage repositories, alongside evaluating perimeter physical delay barriers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Perimeter physical delay barriers（BAR）
information_points.content:
SEC-BAR-Q0X：Pennine Limestone Cavern Repository provides a forced entry delay duration of 45 min against sustained mechanical and thermal breaching attempts at its outer vault portal reinforced blast doors.
SEC-BAR-UCI：Cotswold Deep Bunker Complex provides a forced entry delay duration of 30 min against sustained mechanical and thermal breaching attempts at its outer vault portal reinforced blast doors.
SEC-BAR-TYX：Grampian Subterranean Rock Vault provides a forced entry delay duration of 60 min against sustained mechanical and thermal breaching attempts at its outer vault portal reinforced blast doors.

information_points.title: Enforces physical access security perimeter standards, biometric verifications, and tactical watch personnel（PROT）
information_points.content:
SEC-PROT-RZJ：For Pennine Limestone Cavern Repository, biometric multi-factor access control is not certified across all inner vault airlock entry portals via active retina and palm vein authentication. Under a watch hour accounting basis including mandatory guard relief and handover intervals, weekly armed security guard watch hours stand at 112 h.
SEC-PROT-J6V：For Grampian Subterranean Rock Vault, biometric multi-factor access control is certified across all inner vault airlock entry portals via active retina and palm vein authentication. On a watch hour accounting basis including mandatory guard relief and handover intervals, the facility registers 140 h of weekly armed security guard watch hours.
SEC-PROT-756：Under an alternative record for Grampian Subterranean Rock Vault evaluated on a watch hour accounting basis excluding mandatory guard relief and handover intervals, biometric multi-factor access control is not certified across all inner vault airlock entry portals, and weekly armed security guard watch hours are listed as 112 h.
SEC-PROT-OO4：For Cotswold Deep Bunker Complex, biometric multi-factor access control is certified across all inner vault airlock entry portals via active retina and palm vein authentication. On a watch hour accounting basis including mandatory guard relief and handover intervals, its weekly armed security guard watch hours total 112 h.
